description: A government authority sends an urgent directive requiring immediate action regarding new tax compliance.

mail.subject: URGENT: New Tax Compliance Requirements
mail.content_summary: You must update your company’s tax reporting procedures immediately to comply with new regulations.

description: The HR department instructs employees to immediately update their personal details for payroll processing.

mail.subject: Immediate action required: Update your personal details
mail.content_summary: Please log into the employee portal and update your bank details by end of day today.

description: A project manager shares an urgent FYI about a critical bug fix for the ongoing project.

mail.subject: Project Alpha: Critical bug fix deployment
mail.content_summary: Please be aware that a critical patch has been deployed; no action is needed now, but stay alert for updates.

description: A supplier requests approval of a quotation for an upcoming order.

mail.subject: Quotation #20345 awaiting your approval
mail.content_summary: Please review and approve the attached quotation for office supplies so we can process your order.

description: The finance team shares the monthly sales report for colleagues’ reference; no action required.

mail.subject: Monthly sales report – FYI
mail.content_summary: Attached is the sales report for September.  This is for your information only.

description: A marketing automation system sends a promotional email about discounted training courses.

mail.subject: Special promotion: 50% off leadership courses
mail.content_summary: Limited‑time offer on our leadership development courses. Click here to enroll.

description: An automated system sends a weekly newsletter about upcoming company events.

mail.subject: Acme weekly newsletter
mail.content_summary: Highlights of upcoming events and employee spotlights.

description: The CEO announces a new corporate strategy initiative.  The message is for everyone’s awareness.

mail.subject: Important: Acme 2026 strategy roadmap
mail.content_summary: We are embarking on a new three‑year strategy. No immediate action is required, but stay tuned.

description: A colleague invites you to a team lunch next week; no work action is needed.

mail.subject: Team lunch next Wednesday at noon
mail.content_summary: Let’s have lunch together next Wednesday at Pho 2000 after our sprint review.

description: A generic spam email promises a prize if you click a link.

mail.subject: Congratulations! You’ve won a brand‑new phone
mail.content_summary: Click here to claim your free smartphone in our sweepstakes.
